messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "can be increased to 10 mg three times a day if needed"
set: ["can be increased to 10 mg three times a day if needed", "increased to 10 mg three times a day based on your response", "taken up to three times a day", "can be increased by 100 mg every 5 days if needed", "increase to 100 mg orally three times a day after 3 days", "immediate-release tablets are taken three times a day", "three times daily", "dose can be raised in steps of 25 mg to 50 mg a day", "8 mg taken orally 2 times a day", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "initial dose 10 mg orally once a day", "final dosage is 25 mg four times a day", "dose may be increased to 20 mg once a day after at least 3 weeks of treatment if necessary", "day of weekly administration can be changed if necessary", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "target dose is equivalent to one 50 mg tablet four times a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
